Advantages of CNC Technology Applications of CNC Technology in Manufacturing CNC Machine Technology Industrial CNC Technology CNC Technology Services Future Trends in CNC Technology Conclusion CNC technology plays a strategic role in modern manufacturing ecosystems by enabling scalable, automated, and data-driven production across multiple industries. Rather than focusing on individual machines, CNC technology connects digital design, machining processes, and quality systems into an integrated manufacturing workflow. This allows manufacturers to achieve higher throughput, tighter tolerances, and more predictable production outcomes across the entire product lifecycle. By integrating digital design files with computer-controlled machinery, CNC systems allow manufacturers to produce complex parts with consistent accuracy, scalability, and efficiency. From prototyping to full-scale industrial production, CNC technology supports faster workflows, tighter tolerances, and seamless coordination between design, machining, and quality control. For readers who want a clear definition of CNC and a foundational explanation of how CNC machines operate, we provide a dedicated CNC meaning and definition guide that focuses specifically on terminology and basic concepts. To translate CNC technology into real manufacturing outcomes, professional machining services play a critical role. JLCCNC provides CNC machining solutions that support prototyping, small-batch production, and industrial-scale manufacturing, enabling companies to apply CNC technology efficiently without investing in in-house capacity. What is CNC Technology? CNC technology refers to the integrated use of software, control systems, and automated machinery to manage and execute precision manufacturing processes. In modern production environments, CNC technology functions as a core manufacturing platform—linking digital design data with machining operations, tool management, and quality control systems. Advantages of CNC Technology CNC technology offers a wide range of advantages that make it essential to modern manufacturing. By combining computer-controlled automation with high-performance machinery, CNC systems significantly improve manufacturing efficiency. They also enable superior quality and scalability across diverse industries. High Precision and Consistent Accuracy One of the most significant advantages of CNC technology is its ability to deliver extremely high precision. CNC technology can repeatedly produce components with tight tolerances that are difficult or impossible to achieve through manual machining. Once a program is validated, the same dimensions and surface quality can be maintained across thousands of parts, ensuring consistent accuracy even in complex geometries. This level of precision is especially critical in industries such as aerospace, automotive, medical devices, and electronics, where small dimensional deviations can affect performance, safety, or compliance with industry standards. Increased Production Efficiency CNC technology dramatically improves production efficiency by automating machining operations. Machines can run continuously with minimal operator intervention, reducing setup time and accelerating production cycles. Multi-axis CNC systems further enhance efficiency by completing multiple operations—such as milling, drilling, and contouring—in a single setup. Automated tool changes, optimized tool paths, and high-speed machining capabilities allow manufacturers to shorten lead times and respond quickly to changing production demands. Excellent Repeatability and Quality Control Repeatability is a core strength of CNC technology. Every part produced from the same CNC program is virtually identical, minimizing variation and reducing scrap rates. This repeatability simplifies quality control processes, as fewer manual inspections are required once a process is stabilized. CNC systems also integrate easily with in-process measurement and inspection technologies, enabling real-time quality monitoring and early detection of deviations before defects occur. Material and Design Versatility CNC technology supports a wide range of materials, including metals, plastics, composites, and engineered alloys. From aluminum and stainless steel to advanced polymers and titanium, CNC machines can be optimized to handle different cutting characteristics and surface finish requirements. A common example is aluminum CNC machining , which is widely used due to aluminum’s excellent machinability and strength-to-weight ratio. In addition, CNC technology enables the machining of complex shapes, internal features, and intricate contours that would be extremely time-consuming or impractical with conventional methods. This design freedom allows engineers to innovate without being limited by manufacturing constraints. Scalability from Prototyping to Mass Production Another key advantage of CNC technology is its scalability. The same CNC setup can be used for rapid prototyping, small-batch production, and high-volume manufacturing with minimal modification. Design changes can be implemented quickly by updating the digital program rather than retooling entire production lines. This flexibility is particularly valuable for startups, R&D teams, and manufacturers operating in fast-moving markets where product iterations are frequent. Reduced Labor Dependency and Improved Safety By automating machining tasks, CNC technology reduces reliance on manual labor and lowers the risk of human error. Operators are less exposed to cutting tools and moving machine components, resulting in a safer working environment. Modern CNC systems also feature built-in safety controls, error detection, and machine monitoring functions that further protect both personnel and equipment while maintaining stable production. Cost Efficiency Over the Product Lifecycle While CNC machines require an initial investment, they offer long-term cost advantages. Reduced material waste, lower rework rates, shorter production times, and improved machine utilization all contribute to a lower cost per part over the product lifecycle. For manufacturers seeking consistent quality, predictable output, and efficient resource usage, CNC technology represents a cost-effective solution that supports sustainable growth. Applications of CNC Technology in Manufacturing CNC technology has a wide range of applications across industries due to its ability to deliver high precision, consistency, and production efficiency. From large-scale industrial manufacturing to rapid prototyping, CNC technology continues to expand as materials, software, and machine capabilities evolve. Applications in Metalworking CNC milling machines, lathes, and laser cutters handle metals like aluminum, steel, and titanium with unmatched precision. These machines reduce manual labor, minimize errors, and allow for complex shapes that meet rigorous industry standards. In metalworking industries where tolerance control and material consistency are critical, CNC technology enables reliable production of complex metal components at scale. Applications in Plastics and Woodworking Beyond metals, CNC routers can cut, engrave, and shape plastic components or wood panels with high accuracy. Routers are typically used for wood and plastic materials, while milling machines are better suited for metal machining due to their rigidity and cutting capabilities. Manufacturers can efficiently produce prototypes and mass-produced items, lowering production costs and turnaround times. Industrial Applications Industries such as automotive, aerospace, electronics, energy, and heavy machinery rely on CNC systems to produce structural components, housings, brackets, and precision parts. CNC machining ensures tight tolerances, repeatability, and high reliability for critical components. Prototyping and Small Batch Production Rapid prototyping and small-batch CNC production allow engineers to quickly transform digital designs into functional prototypes, enabling faster design validation, iterative testing, and reduced time-to-market. Innovative Uses in Various Industries Advanced applications such as multi-axis cutting, hybrid additive-subtractive manufacturing, and complex 3D contour machining expand possibilities in medical devices, architecture, and custom design. CNC Machine Technology Types of CNC Machines CNC machine technology includes milling machines, lathes, routers, plasma cutters, and laser engraving systems. Each type serves a specific function, from cutting and drilling to shaping and engraving, meeting diverse manufacturing needs. How CNC Machines Work CNC machines operate by translating digital designs into precise machining actions through integrated control systems. This enables highly accurate and repeatable production while minimizing material waste and optimizing workflow efficiency. Maintenance and Optimization Proper maintenance of CNC machines is essential for long-term performance. Regular calibration, tool replacement, and software updates optimize machine efficiency and prevent downtime. Skilled operators can further enhance productivity by choosing the right tooling and machining parameters. Industrial CNC Technology Automation in Large-Scale Production Industrial CNC technology enables full automation of production lines. Large-scale manufacturing can run continuously with minimal human supervision, improving throughput and reducing labor costs. Integration with Industrial Processes CNC technology integrates seamlessly with industrial processes such as assembly, quality inspection, and material handling. This integration allows for smarter factories, streamlined workflows, and higher overall efficiency. Case Studies Industries adopting industrial CNC technology have reported reduced production errors, faster turnaround times, and improved product consistency. For example, automotive suppliers use CNC machines to produce engine components with precise tolerances, enhancing vehicle performance and reliability. CNC Technology Services Design and Consulting Services CNC technology services extend beyond machining itself. Design and consulting services help manufacturers apply CNC technology effectively by optimizing material selection, machining strategies, and process planning before production begins. Manufacturing and Prototyping Services Service providers offer CNC machining for both prototypes and mass production. This allows businesses to outsource specialized tasks, reduce overhead, and maintain high-quality standards. Maintenance and Support Services Many CNC technology service providers also offer ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and training. This ensures clients can maintain efficient operations, extend machine lifespan, and minimize production delays. Future Trends in CNC Technology Beyond basic CNC operation and machine control, future CNC technology development is increasingly driven by intelligence, connectivity, and system-level integration. Future developments will not only improve precision and productivity but also fundamentally reshape how factories operate, how products are designed, and how manufacturers compete in global markets. Smart CNC and AI Integration The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) with CNC systems is transforming machining from reactive automation into predictive and adaptive manufacturing. AI-powered algorithms can analyze historical machining data. They automatically optimize tool paths, reduce cycle times, and minimize tool wear. Machine learning models are increasingly used to detect subtle signs of tool degradation or misalignment before they cause defects. In aerospace and medical device manufacturing, where tolerances are extremely tight, AI-assisted CNC tool path optimization is already being adopted to ensure consistency and precision across complex geometries. Over time, smart CNC machines will be able to adjust cutting strategies in real time, self-correcting for material inconsistencies and dynamic load variations without human intervention. IoT and Connected Manufacturing The rise of the Internet of Things (IoT) enables CNC machines to become integral components of connected smart factories. Sensors embedded in CNC equipment collect real-time data on temperature, vibration, spindle load, and tool life. This data, streamed through secure networks, feeds into centralized manufacturing execution systems (MES) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems to support real-time monitoring and informed decision-making. Connected CNC machines can automatically schedule maintenance based on actual usage patterns, reducing unplanned downtime. In facilities with multiple machines producing different parts, IoT connectivity enhances workflow coordination, material tracking, and quality control, leading to higher operational efficiency and lower production costs. Advanced Materials and Machining Techniques As new materials continue to emerge, CNC technology evolves to address the challenges they present. Advanced composites, high-entropy alloys (HEAs) , and next-generation polymers have unique machining requirements. High-entropy alloys are composed of multiple principal elements in near-equal proportions, offering exceptional strength, wear resistance, and thermal stability. These materials are increasingly used in aerospace and energy applications, where CNC machining must precisely control cutting forces and heat generation to maintain part integrity. CNC technology is also incorporating hybrid manufacturing techniques that combine additive manufacturing (3D printing) with traditional subtractive machining. These hybrid processes allow complex internal structures to be built additively and then finished with high-precision CNC cutting, making them ideal for lightweight aerospace components and customized medical implants. Human–Machine Collaboration and Augmented Reality Future CNC environments will emphasize human–machine collaboration, where operators work alongside intelligent machining systems rather than simply monitoring them. Augmented reality (AR) tools will support setup, training, and maintenance by overlaying digital instructions directly onto physical machinery. Technicians wearing AR headsets will be guided step-by-step through complex calibration or repair processes, reducing training time and lowering the risk of error. Furthermore, virtual simulation environments will allow engineers to preview machining operations before any material is cut. This not only helps validate designs but also ensures that tooling and fixturing are optimized for efficiency and safety. Conclusion Summary of Key Benefits CNC technology has transformed modern manufacturing by improving precision, efficiency, and flexibility. It enables complex machining, reduces errors, and accelerates production cycles. Impact on Modern Manufacturing With industrial CNC technology, advanced machines, and comprehensive services, manufacturers can achieve high-quality output, innovate rapidly, and maintain a competitive edge. As CNC technology continues to evolve, its influence on the manufacturing industry will only grow stronger. High Precision and Consistent Accuracy One of the most significant advantages of CNC technology is its ability to deliver extremely high precision. CNC technology can repeatedly produce components with tight tolerances that are difficult or impossible to achieve through manual machining. Once a program is validated, the same dimensions and surface quality can be maintained across thousands of parts, ensuring consistent accuracy even in complex geometries. This level of precision is especially critical in industries such as aerospace, automotive, medical devices, and electronics, where small dimensional deviations can affect performance, safety, or compliance with industry standards. Increased Production Efficiency CNC technology dramatically improves production efficiency by automating machining operations. Machines can run continuously with minimal operator intervention, reducing setup time and accelerating production cycles. Multi-axis CNC systems further enhance efficiency by completing multiple operations—such as milling, drilling, and contouring—in a single setup. Automated tool changes, optimized tool paths, and high-speed machining capabilities allow manufacturers to shorten lead times and respond quickly to changing production demands. Excellent Repeatability and Quality Control Repeatability is a core strength of CNC technology. Every part produced from the same CNC program is virtually identical, minimizing variation and reducing scrap rates. This repeatability simplifies quality control processes, as fewer manual inspections are required once a process is stabilized. CNC systems also integrate easily with in-process measurement and inspection technologies, enabling real-time quality monitoring and early detection of deviations before defects occur. Material and Design Versatility CNC technology supports a wide range of materials, including metals, plastics, composites, and engineered alloys. From aluminum and stainless steel to advanced polymers and titanium, CNC machines can be optimized to handle different cutting characteristics and surface finish requirements. A common example is aluminum CNC machining , which is widely used due to aluminum’s excellent machinability and strength-to-weight ratio. In addition, CNC technology enables the machining of complex shapes, internal features, and intricate contours that would be extremely time-consuming or impractical with conventional methods. This design freedom allows engineers to innovate without being limited by manufacturing constraints. Scalability from Prototyping to Mass Production Another key advantage of CNC technology is its scalability. The same CNC setup can be used for rapid prototyping, small-batch production, and high-volume manufacturing with minimal modification. Design changes can be implemented quickly by updating the digital program rather than retooling entire production lines. This flexibility is particularly valuable for startups, R&D teams, and manufacturers operating in fast-moving markets where product iterations are frequent. Reduced Labor Dependency and Improved Safety By automating machining tasks, CNC technology reduces reliance on manual labor and lowers the risk of human error. Operators are less exposed to cutting tools and moving machine components, resulting in a safer working environment. Modern CNC systems also feature built-in safety controls, error detection, and machine monitoring functions that further protect both personnel and equipment while maintaining stable production. Cost Efficiency Over the Product Lifecycle While CNC machines require an initial investment, they offer long-term cost advantages. Reduced material waste, lower rework rates, shorter production times, and improved machine utilization all contribute to a lower cost per part over the product lifecycle. For manufacturers seeking consistent quality, predictable output, and efficient resource usage, CNC technology represents a cost-effective solution that supports sustainable growth. Applications of CNC Technology in Manufacturing CNC technology has a wide range of applications across industries due to its ability to deliver high precision, consistency, and production efficiency. From large-scale industrial manufacturing to rapid prototyping, CNC technology continues to expand as materials, software, and machine capabilities evolve. Applications in Metalworking CNC milling machines, lathes, and laser cutters handle metals like aluminum, steel, and titanium with unmatched precision. These machines reduce manual labor, minimize errors, and allow for complex shapes that meet rigorous industry standards. In metalworking industries where tolerance control and material consistency are critical, CNC technology enables reliable production of complex metal components at scale. Applications in Plastics and Woodworking Beyond metals, CNC routers can cut, engrave, and shape plastic components or wood panels with high accuracy. Routers are typically used for wood and plastic materials, while milling machines are better suited for metal machining due to their rigidity and cutting capabilities. Manufacturers can efficiently produce prototypes and mass-produced items, lowering production costs and turnaround times. Industrial Applications Industries such as automotive, aerospace, electronics, energy, and heavy machinery rely on CNC systems to produce structural components, housings, brackets, and precision parts. CNC machining ensures tight tolerances, repeatability, and high reliability for critical components. Prototyping and Small Batch Production Rapid prototyping and small-batch CNC production allow engineers to quickly transform digital designs into functional prototypes, enabling faster design validation, iterative testing, and reduced time-to-market. Innovative Uses in Various Industries Advanced applications such as multi-axis cutting, hybrid additive-subtractive manufacturing, and complex 3D contour machining expand possibilities in medical devices, architecture, and custom design. CNC Machine Technology Types of CNC Machines CNC machine technology includes milling machines, lathes, routers, plasma cutters, and laser engraving systems. Each type serves a specific function, from cutting and drilling to shaping and engraving, meeting diverse manufacturing needs. How CNC Machines Work CNC machines operate by translating digital designs into precise machining actions through integrated control systems. This enables highly accurate and repeatable production while minimizing material waste and optimizing workflow efficiency. Maintenance and Optimization Proper maintenance of CNC machines is essential for long-term performance. Regular calibration, tool replacement, and software updates optimize machine efficiency and prevent downtime. Skilled operators can further enhance productivity by choosing the right tooling and machining parameters. Industrial CNC Technology Automation in Large-Scale Production Industrial CNC technology enables full automation of production lines. Large-scale manufacturing can run continuously with minimal human supervision, improving throughput and reducing labor costs. Integration with Industrial Processes CNC technology integrates seamlessly with industrial processes such as assembly, quality inspection, and material handling. This integration allows for smarter factories, streamlined workflows, and higher overall efficiency. Case Studies Industries adopting industrial CNC technology have reported reduced production errors, faster turnaround times, and improved product consistency. For example, automotive suppliers use CNC machines to produce engine components with precise tolerances, enhancing vehicle performance and reliability. CNC Technology Services Design and Consulting Services CNC technology services extend beyond machining itself. Design and consulting services help manufacturers apply CNC technology effectively by optimizing material selection, machining strategies, and process planning before production begins. Manufacturing and Prototyping Services Service providers offer CNC machining for both prototypes and mass production. This allows businesses to outsource specialized tasks, reduce overhead, and maintain high-quality standards. Maintenance and Support Services Many CNC technology service providers also offer ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and training. This ensures clients can maintain efficient operations, extend machine lifespan, and minimize production delays. Future Trends in CNC Technology Beyond basic CNC operation and machine control, future CNC technology development is increasingly driven by intelligence, connectivity, and system-level integration. Future developments will not only improve precision and productivity but also fundamentally reshape how factories operate, how products are designed, and how manufacturers compete in global markets. Smart CNC and AI Integration The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) with CNC systems is transforming machining from reactive automation into predictive and adaptive manufacturing. AI-powered algorithms can analyze historical machining data. They automatically optimize tool paths, reduce cycle times, and minimize tool wear. Machine learning models are increasingly used to detect subtle signs of tool degradation or misalignment before they cause defects. In aerospace and medical device manufacturing, where tolerances are extremely tight, AI-assisted CNC tool path optimization is already being adopted to ensure consistency and precision across complex geometries. Over time, smart CNC machines will be able to adjust cutting strategies in real time, self-correcting for material inconsistencies and dynamic load variations without human intervention. IoT and Connected Manufacturing The rise of the Internet of Things (IoT) enables CNC machines to become integral components of connected smart factories. Sensors embedded in CNC equipment collect real-time data on temperature, vibration, spindle load, and tool life. This data, streamed through secure networks, feeds into centralized manufacturing execution systems (MES) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems to support real-time monitoring and informed decision-making. Connected CNC machines can automatically schedule maintenance based on actual usage patterns, reducing unplanned downtime. In facilities with multiple machines producing different parts, IoT connectivity enhances workflow coordination, material tracking, and quality control, leading to higher operational efficiency and lower production costs. Advanced Materials and Machining Techniques As new materials continue to emerge, CNC technology evolves to address the challenges they present. Advanced composites, high-entropy alloys (HEAs) , and next-generation polymers have unique machining requirements. High-entropy alloys are composed of multiple principal elements in near-equal proportions, offering exceptional strength, wear resistance, and thermal stability. These materials are increasingly used in aerospace and energy applications, where CNC machining must precisely control cutting forces and heat generation to maintain part integrity. CNC technology is also incorporating hybrid manufacturing techniques that combine additive manufacturing (3D printing) with traditional subtractive machining. These hybrid processes allow complex internal structures to be built additively and then finished with high-precision CNC cutting, making them ideal for lightweight aerospace components and customized medical implants. Human–Machine Collaboration and Augmented Reality Future CNC environments will emphasize human–machine collaboration, where operators work alongside intelligent machining systems rather than simply monitoring them. Augmented reality (AR) tools will support setup, training, and maintenance by overlaying digital instructions directly onto physical machinery. Technicians wearing AR headsets will be guided step-by-step through complex calibration or repair processes, reducing training time and lowering the risk of error. Furthermore, virtual simulation environments will allow engineers to preview machining operations before any material is cut. This not only helps validate designs but also ensures that tooling and fixturing are optimized for efficiency and safety. Conclusion Summary of Key Benefits CNC technology has transformed modern manufacturing by improving precision, efficiency, and flexibility. It enables complex machining, reduces errors, and accelerates production cycles. Impact on Modern Manufacturing With industrial CNC technology, advanced machines, and comprehensive services, manufacturers can achieve high-quality output, innovate rapidly, and maintain a competitive edge. As CNC technology continues to evolve, its influence on the manufacturing industry will only grow stronger. events.before: Help Center Help Center Plastic CNC Machining PMMA (Acrylic) CNC Machining Help Center Ordering CNC Machining Ordering Sheet Metal Ordering CNC Machining Materials Aluminum CNC Machining Copper CNC Machining Plastic CNC Machining Stainless Steel CNC Machining Steel Alloy CNC Machining Sheet Metal Materials Aluminum Stainless Steel Alloy Steel CNC Machining Tutorials CNC Machining Design CNC Machining Knowledge Sheet Metal Tutorials Sheet Metal Design CNC Machine Basic Knowledge 5-Axis CNC Machine Privacy&Policies Coupon Policy Shipping Policies Policies PMMA (Acrylic) CNC Machining Last updated on Jan 06, 2026 Acrylic, also known as PMMA or Plexiglas, is from the English acrylic (acrylic plastic), and is the chemical name of polymethyl methacrylate. Is an important early development of plastic polymer materials, with good transparency, chemical stability, and weather resistance, easy to dye, easy to process, and beautiful appearance, in the construction industry and has a wide range of applications. Plexiglass products can usually be divided into cast sheets, extruded sheets, and molded plastics. Mechanical Properties Polymethyl methacrylate has good overall mechanical properties and is at the forefront of general-purpose plastics. Its tensile, bending, and compression strengths are higher than those of polyolefins and higher than those of polystyrene and polyvinyl chloride, etc. Its impact toughness is poor, but it is also slightly better than that of polystyrene. The mechanical properties of tensile, bending, and compression are higher for cast polymerized polymethyl methacrylate sheets (such as plexiglass sheets for aviation), which can reach the level of polyamide, polycarbonate, and other engineering plastics. Generally speaking, the tensile strength of polymethyl methacrylate can reach the level of 50-77MPa and the bending strength can reach 90-130MPa, and the upper limit of these performance data has reached or even exceeded some engineering plastics. Its elongation at break is only 2%-3%, so the mechanical properties are basically hard and brittle plastic and have a gap sensitivity, easy to crack under stress, but the fracture is not as sharp and uneven as polystyrene and ordinary inorganic glass. 40 ℃ is a secondary transition temperature, which is equivalent to the temperature at which the side methyl starts to move, and over 40 ℃, the toughness of the material, and ductility improved. Polymethyl methacrylate has low surface hardness and is easily scuffed. The strength of polymethyl methacrylate is related to the time of stress action and decreases with the increase of action time. The mechanical properties of polymethyl methacrylate (oriented plexiglass) after tensile orientation are significantly improved and notch sensitivity is also improved. The heat resistance of polymethyl methacrylate is not high. Although its glass transition temperature reaches 104°C, the maximum continuous use temperature changes between 65°C and 95°C with different working conditions, the heat deflection temperature is about 96°C (1.18 MPa), and the Vicat softening point is about 113°C. Heat resistance can be improved by copolymerization of monomer with acrylate methacrylate or glycol bis-ester acrylate. The cold resistance of polymethyl methacrylate is also poor, with a brittleness temperature of about 9.2°C. The thermal stability of polymethyl methacrylate is medium, better than polyvinyl chloride and polyformaldehyde, but less than polyolefin and polystyrene, thermal decomposition temperature is slightly higher than 270 ℃, its flow temperature is about 160 ℃, so there is still a wide range of melt processing temperature. The thermal conductivity and specific heat capacity of polymethyl methacrylate are medium in plastics, 0.19W/M.K and 1464J/Kg.K respectively. Was this article helpful? Yes No Help Center

events.before: Home Newsroom JLC Global launches CNC Machining Service JLC Global launches CNC Machining Service Product Update Aug 16, 2024 Table of Contents What Make JLC Global' CNC Machining Service Different? Quality & Delivery In Conclusion We're proud to announce that our CNC Machining service officially launched in July of this year. Thank s to t he trust and support of all of you. W e've seamlessly transitioned from a trial run to a fully operational service and gained recognition from an ever-growing customer base in just three months with the fine-tuned process. What Make JLC Global ' CNC Machining Service Different? We offer a wide spectrum of machining services with cutting-edge technology. Our impressive array of processing equipment includes 3-axis and 5-axis machining centers, 3+2 machining, lathes, milling-turning combinations, wire cutting, electrical discharge machining, surface grinding, gear hobbing machines, tapping machines, ultrasonic cleaning machines, sandblasting machines, deburring machines, and laser marking machines. Not limited to metal alloys such as aluminum (6061, 7075) and copper (brass, bronze), we are also proficient in working with plastic materials like ABS, engineering plastics, electric wood, and acrylic. What sets us apart is our comprehensive offering of surface treatments, including sandblasting, brushing, anodizing, laser marking and etc. Quality & Delivery Quality and on-time delivery have always been our top priorities. To ensure the highest quality standards, we've invested in state-of-the-art inspection equipment such as two-dimensional and 3D scanning measurement devices, flash testers, spectral analyzers, tool wear detection equipment, height gauges, a complete set of gauges, thread gauges, micrometers and etc. Our experienced quality engineers oversee structural component inspections, guaranteeing reliable product and services for you. . While our CNC business currently focuses on prototyping and small batches, we're committed to serving a broader customer base. On average, our prototype orders have a lead time of approximately 5 days, with the possibility of expedited production in as fast as 3 days. We're continuously optimizing our processes to provide even more efficient services. In Conclusion Thank you for being an integral part of our journey to success! Your support means the world to JLC Global ! We will try our best in continuing to provide the best services to all of you! Keep Joining us in this incredible journey towards CNC machining. Get free quote now! Table of Contents What Make JLC Global' CNC Machining Service Different? Quality & Delivery In Conclusion

events.before: Home Newsroom Important Notice: Logistics Policy Updates due to the US’s tariff on China Important Notice: Logistics Policy Updates due to the US’s tariff on China Price Update Apr 23, 2025 Table of Contents US Tariff Timeline: New options available: Notes: US Tariff Timeline: February 4, 2025: U.S. President Donald Trump imposed 10% tariffs on all Chinese imports March 3, 2025: The US levied an additional 10% tariff on China, leading to a total of 20% tariffs April 5, 2025: The US's 10% reciprocal tariff went into effect and will impose 34% reciprocal tariffs on April 9 April 9, 2025: The US increased the reciprocal tariffs from 34% to 84% April 10, 2025: The US again raised the reciprocal tariffs on Chinese goods to 125% Taking into account the additional tariff and reciprocal tariffs, the total amounts to 145% . Due to the fluctuating customs duty rate (145%~175%), we will collect taxes from customers in advance based on the highest rate of 175%. After receiving the tax bill from the logistics provider, any excess will be refunded, and any shortfall will be charged accordingly. See more details here: https://jlccnc.com/help/article/us-tariff-policy-faq The following adjustments have been made: Effective from 20:20 on April 22nd(GMT+8), B2C customers placing orders destined for the United States are required to choose DDP when selecting the shipping method and prepay 175% of the order value as taxes. New options available: · DHL Express Priority (DDP) · FedEx International Priority (DDP) · UPS Express Saver (DDP) Notes: 1. All tax charges can be adjusted after actual tax bills are issued by the carriers. Any excess will be refunded, and any shortfall will be charged accordingly. 2. events.before: Home Newsroom JLCCNC Now Supports Merged Ordering with JLCMC JLCCNC Now Supports Merged Ordering with JLCMC Product Update Dec 18, 2025 Table of Contents Three Reasons to Merge Your Orders How to Place a Merged Order Better Supporting Manufacturing Needs Through Stronger Platform Collaboration Media Contact: JLCCNC is thrilled to announce a significant upgrade to its ordering experience. Starting December 13, merged ordering capabilities have been further expanded across the JLCMC mechanical ecosystem. Previously, merged ordering was already available for services such as 3D printing and sheet metal fabrication. With this update, JLCCNC orders can now be combined with JLCMC products in the same checkout, with consolidated shipping and a unified batch number. Three Reasons to Merge Your Orders 1. One Workflow for Everything By adding products from different business lines to one cart, you reduce administrative overhead and eliminate the need to track multiple payment requests. 2. Reduced Logistics Costs Consolidated shipping allows you to bundle those diverse items into one package. This reduces the number of base-weight charges you pay and simplifies receiving logistics. 3. Unified Order Management Managing multiple order numbers increases the risk of error. You will receive a unified batch number for all your items, making tracking more intuitive and ensuring all parts of your project arrive together. How to Place a Merged Order 1. Add your CNC machining parts, along with other items such as JLCMC products, to your shopping cart. 2. Go to the Shopping Cart page and select the “All” checkbox to group your items from different platforms. 3. Confirm the merged order and the system will automatically generate a unified batch number and calculate a single shipping rate for the merged order. Better Supporting Manufacturing Needs Through Stronger Platform Collaboration With this enhancement, we make it easier to manage projects that involve multiple manufacturing methods and bulk production while maintaining consistent and reliable CNC machining services. JLCCNC will continue refining its services to help engineers and manufacturing teams reduce coordination effort and move more efficiently from design to production. About JLCCNC JLCCNC offers professional CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication services, supporting prototyping, small-batch production, and custom part manufacturing. With advanced production capabilities, a wide range of materials, and multiple surface finishing options, we deliver precise and reliable parts with efficient turnaround times to support engineers, designers, and manufacturers worldwide. events.before: Home Newsroom JLCCNC CNC Prototyping Subsidy: Parts from $2 JLCCNC CNC Prototyping Subsidy: Parts from $2 Events Nov 09, 2026 Table of Contents CNC Prototype Parts Starting at $2 Manufacturing Standards for Promotional Parts How to Apply for the CNC Prototyping Subsidy JLCCNC is offering special pricing on CNC-machined prototypes for hardware developers and product designers. Customers can receive special pricing on up to 10 CNC prototype parts per month , with prices ranging from $2 to $7 per part . The offer is designed for functional metal prototypes, giving developers a more affordable way to test their designs before placing a standard CNC order. Pricing depends on the part's dimensions and the machining work required. CNC Prototype Parts Starting at $2 The promotion covers Aluminum 6061 parts within the following dimensional limits: Without side features: From 2×2×2mm to 200×200×15mm. Length and width cannot both be below 10mm. With side features: From 25×5×6mm to 100×90×55mm. Side holes and pockets are supported, along with slots. The system can also automatically detect threaded holes through DFM analysis. The final promotional price depends on the part design and its machining requirements. Manufacturing Standards for Promotional Parts Promotional parts use Aluminum 6061 as the default material, with bead blasting and anodizing as the standard surface finish. JLCCNC machines these parts to ISO 2768-m (Medium) tolerances. Automatic thread recognition is supported, and a default C0.2 mm chamfer at 45° is applied to edges. The promotion is intended for functional prototypes rather than high-end cosmetic parts. Minor surface blemishes are not covered by the promotional claim policy. This exclusion also applies to slight anodizing shade variations and rack contact marks. Customers who need Class-A cosmetic surfaces should place a standard CNC machining order. How to Apply for the CNC Prototyping Subsidy To participate, upload a 3D CAD model in STEP or STP format through the Monthly CNC Prototyping Subsidy page . Files can be up to 100 MB. Each uploaded model first goes through an automated AI DFM check. JLCCNC's engineering team then reviews the design manually before production. Parts that do not pass manual verification will not qualify for the promotion. Each customer can receive special pricing on up to 10 parts per month. Daily promotional slots depend on factory capacity and are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Each customer is limited to one account under the fair-use policy. The subsidy program is ongoing. For complete eligibility requirements and CAD preparation instructions, visit the special deal design guidelines before uploading a model. events.before: Home Newsroom JLCCNC Service Update: Price Adjustment for CNC Machining Services JLCCNC Service Update: Price Adjustment for CNC Machining Services Price Update May 08, 2026 Table of Contents Core Reasons for Adjustment Implementation Details Our Commitment to Your Success [May 8, 2026] – To our valued customers and partners, Thank you for your continued trust in JLCCNC. We are dedicated to providing the high-precision, stable, and reliable CNC manufacturing services your projects demand. Following a comprehensive evaluation of current market conditions, JLCCNC will implement a price adjustment for our CNC machining services, effective May 8, 2026 (18:00 UTC+8) . This decision is driven by sustained and significant cost increases in core raw materials and manufacturing consumables. Core Reasons for Adjustment ● Surge in Tooling Costs: The price of Tungsten Powder—the primary raw material for high-performance CNC cutting tools—has surged by 491% year-over-year. This unprecedented spike has drastically increased our operational consumables cost. ● Rising Raw Material Prices: The market price of Aluminum, our most frequently utilized processing material, has risen by 20%, leading to higher procurement expenses across our supply chain. Implementation Details ● Effective Date: May 8, 2026 (18:00 UTC+8). ● Instant Quote System: Updated pricing will be reflected automatically in the [JLCCNC Online Instant Quote System] . ● Market-Linked Flexibility: JLCCNC maintains a dynamic pricing model. Should the market prices of Tungsten or Aluminum decrease, we will adjust and lower our processing fees accordingly at the earliest opportunity. Note: Due to ongoing market volatility, future pricing updates may be applied directly to our online system without separate formal announcements. Our Commitment to Your Success We recognize that pricing changes impact your project planning. This adjustment is essential to ensure we do not compromise on the quality and delivery stability you expect from JLCCNC. We remain committed to your success through: ● Strict Quality Assurance: Maintaining rigorous inspection standards for every part. ● Global Competitiveness: Ensuring our pricing remains highly competitive compared to international benchmarks, without sacrificing quality. ● Expert Technical Support: Our engineering team remains available 24/7 for material selection and process optimization to help you mitigate costs. We sincerely appreciate your understanding of this market-driven decision. We look forward to our continued partnership and to delivering the exceptional manufacturing solutions your business deserves. At JLCCNC, we combine precision, efficiency, and flexibility to deliver high-quality sheet metal parts — from prototypes to small-batch production. Our advanced sheet metal production line features CNC laser cutting machines, bending machines, punching machines, and welding stations , enabling us to process complex geometries with tight tolerances. We specialize in working with the following materials: Aluminum 5052 Stainless Steel 201 Stainless Steel 304 Cold Rolled Steel Galvanized Steel Sheet Whether it's structural enclosures, electronic housings, or custom brackets, our team ensures excellent fit, finish, and durability for every part. The fastest production cycle can be completed in just one day , providing you with highly efficient and convenient sheet metal services. events.before: Home Newsroom [Ongoing Updates] JLCCNC Policy Adjustments Due to U.S. Tariff on China [Ongoing Updates] JLCCNC Policy Adjustments Due to U.S. Tariff on China Price Update May 16, 2025 Table of Contents Latest Update: 1. Overview of U.S. Tariff Policies on Imports from China 2.What is the rate of JLCCNC's advance tax collection? New Tariff Policy Current Tariff Composition: Updated Tariff Prepayment Plan About Tariff Refunds Special Circumstances US Tariff Timeline: New options available: Notes: This page contains consolidated and continuously updated information regarding changes to JLCPCB, JLCMC, JLCCNC, and JLC3DP's logistics and tax policies affected by the U.S. tariff on China. Please check back regularly for the latest updates. Latest Update: Updated on March 17 , 2026 Effective February 24, 2026, the Reciprocal Tariffs and Fentanyl-related Tariffs have expired. Concurrently, a new 10% provisional tariff has been implemented. In response to these changes,we will adjust the US DDP tariff rates starting March 17, 2026 , resulting in an overall reduction of 10%. Please refer to the table below for details: Type Material Rate PCB / 35.00% SMT / 35.00% Stencil / 90.00% 3D Resin、Nylon、PA12-CF、ABS、ASA、PLA、TPU Plastic 40.00% 3D 316L、BJ-316L 70.00% 3D Titanium TC4 35.00% CNC ABS、POM、Bakelite、PMMA、FR4、Nylon、Polycarbonate 40.00% CNC SUS304 70.00% CNC Aluminum 6061、Aluminum 7075 90.00% CNC Copper - T2 90.00% CNC Brass - H59 90.00% CNC 45# Steel 80.00% FA / 55.00% Sheet Metal Aluminum 90.00% Sheet Metal Stainless Steel 70.00% Sheet Metal Steel Alloy 70.00% Flexible Heater / 35.00% Updated on November 11 , 2025 We will determine the advance tax collection rate based on the product's type and material. Starting November 11, 2025, the additional tariff rate will be reduced from 20% to 10%, along with an overall 10% reduction in prepaid tariffs. Updated on August 12, 2025 On August 11, 2025, the U.S. government issued a joint statement confirming the continued enforcement of Executive Order No. 14257, as amended on May 14. The reciprocal tariff rate will remain at 10% (part of a total 34% rate, with the remaining 24% suspended for an additional 90 days and potentially raised to the full 34% thereafter). JLCCNC's tariff policy for exports to the United States remains unchanged. Updated on June 12, 2025 1. Overview of U.S. Tariff Policies on Imports from China On May 14, 2025, the U.S. government adjusted the tariff rates on Chinese imports, resulting in a general reduction for certain categories of goods. Additional Tariffs: 20% Reciprocal Tariffs: 125% 10% (for 90 days, may be raised to 34% in the future) Section 301 Tariffs: 25% Section 232 Tariffs: 25% 50%(raised on June 4th 2025, the tariff only apply to steel products and aluminum alloy products.) Regular Tariffs under applicable HS codes: 0–7.5% ⇒Total tariff rate: About 55~112.5% 2.What is the rate of JLCCNC's advance tax collection? JLCCNC sets the advance tax rate based on the product type and material: For more details, please refer to our U.S. Tariff Policy FAQ Updated on May 15, 2025 New Tariff Policy On May 12, 2025, the United States has made the following adjustments to tariffs imposed on Chinese goods: -Tariffs on products originating from China will be reduced from 125% to 34%. -Of that 34%, 24% will be suspended for 90 days, meaning that only 10% reciprocal tariff will be collected during this period. Current Tariff Composition: Reciprocal Tariffs: 125% → 10% (issued on May 14, 2025, will change to 34% after 90 days)Additional Tariffs: 20% (issued on March 3, 2025) Section 301 Tariffs: 25% Section 232 Tariffs: 25% (only for steel and aluminum products）Regular Tariffs： 0-7.5% Total cumulative tariffs: 55%-87.5% (for steel and aluminum products) Since orders from JLCCNC to America will not deliver through postal channel, whether the order amount is below or above $800 will be subject to the same tax rate rule. Updated Tariff Prepayment Plan Based on the above regulations and for customer convenience, starting from Beijing Time18:00, May 14, 2025, we will apply a standard pre-collected tariff rate of 55%(May 14) →60%(May 17) for all U.S. orders shipped via DDP (Delivered Duty Paid).This 60% rate is generally fixed and will not be refunded or adjusted based on the actual tax invoice. This rate is calculated as an average based on actual tariff rates ranging from 55% to 87.5%. If the tariff on certain products (such as iron and aluminum items) exceeds 60%, the excess fee will be covered by us. * Due to the evolving nature of U.S.-China tariff policies, JLCCNC’s DDP tariff plan for the U.S. is subject to change at any time. If U.S. Tariff policies change again and affect orders during the adjustment period: -A. If the difference in tariff rates is within ±10%, no adjustments will be made. -B. If the difference exceeds ±10% and the impact per order is over $10 USD, we will refund any overcharged tariff amount based on the tax invoice provided by the logistics provider, and we reserves the right to reclaim any underpaid tariff difference. * JLCCNC is continuously upgrading the billing system and will eventually switch to accurate, order-specific tariff charges. An announcement will be made when this is implemented. About Tariff Refunds For orders placed before May 15, 2025, under the previous 175% pre-charged tariff policy: * If the order was delivered before May 15 and pre-charged at 175%, Once we receives the tariff invoice from the logistics provider, we will refund the difference between the pre-collected tariff and the actual tariff amount shown on the invoice. (The processing period is approximately 1–2 months.) If more than 75 days have passed since the delivery date and JLCCNC has still not received the actual tax invoice, we will offer a partial refund of 25%. Example: If a customer places a $100 order on May 1 with a pre-collected tariff of 175% ($175), and the order is delivered on May 8 when the standard tariff rate is almost 150%, but JLCCNC didn't receivd the actual tax invoice after more than 75 days, JLCCNC will refund the difference fee (175% - 150% = 25%)—which equals $25—on July 22. * If the order was delivered after May 15 and pre-collected at 175%, Once we receives the tariff invoice from the logistics provider, we will refund the difference between the pre-collected tariff and the actual tariff amount shown on the invoice. (The processing period is approximately 1–2 months.)If more than 75 days have passed since the delivery date and JLCCNC has still not received the actual tax invoice, JLCCNC will offer a partial refund of 120%. Example: If a customer places a $100 order on May 11 with a pre-collected tariff of 175% ($175), and the order is delivered on May 18 when the standard tariff rate is 55%, but JLCCNCdidn't receivd the actual tax invoice after more than 75 days, JLCCNC will refund the difference fee (175% - 55% = 120%)—which equals $120—on Aug 1. Special Circumstances If you have a special case—such as applying for a Section 301 exemption, you may contact us to request a refund. For any questions, please contact: logistics@jlcpcb.com Updated on April 23, 2025 US Tariff Timeline: February 4, 2025: U.S. President Donald Trump imposed 10% tariffs on all Chinese imports March 3, 2025: The US levied an additional 10% tariff on China, leading to a total of 20% tariffs April 5, 2025: The US's 10% reciprocal tariff went into effect and will impose 34% reciprocal tariffs on April 9 April 9, 2025: The US increased the reciprocal tariffs from 34% to 84% April 10, 2025: The US again raised the reciprocal tariffs on Chinese goods to 125% Taking into account the additional tariff and reciprocal tariffs, the total amounts to 145% . Due to the fluctuating customs duty rate (145%~175%), we will collect taxes from customers in advance based on the highest rate of 175%. After receiving the tax bill from the logistics provider, any excess will be refunded, and any shortfall will be charged accordingly. The following adjustments have been made: Effective from 20:20 on April 22nd(GMT+8), B2C customers placing orders destined for the United States are required to choose DDP when selecting the shipping method and prepay 175% of the order value as taxes. New options available: · DHL Express Priority (DDP) · FedEx International Priority (DDP) · UPS Express Saver (DDP) Notes: 1. All tax charges can be adjusted after actual tax bills are issued by the carriers. Any excess will be refunded, and any shortfall will be charged accordingly. 2. DHL Express and FedEx Express options are now restricted to corporate customers only. 3. YunExpress small packet options and self-use DHL, FedEx account(Non-DDP) remain unaffected. Be Part of the PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest! by: PCBWay Sep 03,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News We are glad to announce that PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest has arrived. Prior to this, PCBWay successfully held six design contests. In each contest, we saw many eye-catching projects shared by outstanding and creative electronic engineers and enthusiasts. PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest will continue the previous purpose, which is to encourage more and more people to explore the charm of electronic design and participate in it. PCBWay 7th Project Design Contest: https://www.pcbway.com/activity/7th-project-design-contest.html . In this contest, in addition to the two themes of Electronic Project and Mechanical Project that have appeared before, we also introduced STM32 Project, hoping to give designers more room to perform. The contest will start on September 2nd, 2024, and project submissions will be accepted until January 19th, 2025. After this, the judging phase will begin, and the final winners will be announced on the PCBWay Blog on March 10th, 2025. Two ways to participate in the contest: Go to the contest page, find the Participate Now button and click it. In this case, the submitted project will automatically be entered into the competition; participants only need to select the theme of entry. Please note that if you are submitting a mechanical project, please switch to the CNC |3D Printing Project page. After filling in all the project information, simply click "Submit" at the bottom of the page. Go to the SharedProject Community ( https://www.pcbway.com/project/shareproject/ ) and click Create a project. Select the theme you are going to participate in. Similarly, if you are submitting a mechanical project, please switch to the CNC |3D Printing Project page. Hint: Sharing complete project files, including Gerber, BOM, Centroid file, schematics, 3D files, and so on will increase the chances of receiving a higher score. Awards and corresponding prizes: The First Prize : 1 winner, $1500 Cash + $200 Coupon + A Palm-sized Robot Dog*1 The Second Prize : 2 winners, $1000 Cash + $100 Coupon + Raspberry Pi 5 4GB *1 The Third Prize : 3 winners, $500 Cash + $50 Coupon + OpenMV4 H7 R2 Cam Smart Camera *1 Popular Design Prize : 10 winners, $100 Cash + $20 Coupon + $10 3D Printing Coupon + Multimeter ZTY890DPro *1 Participation Prize : Raspberry Pi Pico * 1 STM32 Great Project Prize : Six-Claw Multifunctional Aluminum Alloy Soldering Table *1 For more detailed information about the contest, please refer to: https://www.pcbway.com/activity/7th-project-design-contest.html . If there are any questions or suggestions, feel free to leave a comment below.We wish you the best of luck and look forward to your innovative designs! Verify Now Blog > Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay by: PCBWay May 30,2025 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News PCBWay recognizes the significant role it plays within the supply chain and broader society, along with the potential impact of its operations. To this end, we have established and strictly enforce the following principles, which not only govern our own conduct but also set clear expectations for our partners. Our goal is to ensure full legal and regulatory compliance, promote long-term sustainability, and generate a positive impact on society. Human Rights and Labor Protection No employment of individuals below the legal working age; all forms of forced or bonded labor are strictly prohibited. Discrimination and harassment in the workplace are not tolerated; an inclusive work environment for persons with disabilities is encouraged. Employees must be provided with fair compensation and reasonable rest periods, and their rights to freedom of association and collective bargaining must be respected. Business Ethics and Compliance Offering, promising, soliciting, or accepting any form of bribery is strictly prohibited; effective conflict of interest management and whistleblowing mechanisms must be in place. All financial and business records must accurately, completely, and truthfully reflect the underlying transactions. Full compliance with international sanctions, export controls, and other applicable laws and regulations is required. Supply Chain Responsibility and Sustainable Procurement PCBWay and its partners are required to extend the principles outlined in this document to all levels of entities within the supply chain. Priority should be given to selecting partners that are legally compliant, socially responsible, and committed to sustainable development. Identify social, labor, and environmental risks related to operations, and develop corresponding control and mitigation measures. Encourage partners to prioritize local sourcing to support regional economic development and job creation. Environmental Protection and Workplace Safety Actively implement environmental protection measures and continuously promote energy conservation and emission reduction; Ensure that all waste and hazardous materials are disposed of in accordance with relevant laws and regulations. The procurement or use of prohibited materials is not allowed. Provide employees with a safe working environment and health support mechanisms to prevent occupational injuries and health risks. PCBWay has fully adopted the DHL GoGreen transportation service in 2025 to reduce carbon emissions in the supply chain and promote the development of a green supply chain, with an initial target of reducing emissions by 30%. Information Protection and Transparent Governance Establish a comprehensive security system to strictly protect the confidentiality of customer data, drawings, and other business information. Comply with relevant laws and regulations to safeguard the personal data of customers and employees. Ensure that financial records are true, accurate, and complete, and prohibit any illegal activities. PCBWay will ensure the implementation of the above principles in actual cooperation and reserves the right to take action against any violations. Verify Now Blog > Extrude: Check Your 3D Models on Your Phone Before Printing Extrude: Check Your 3D Models on Your Phone Before Printing by: Mila Nov 19,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Before starting a 3D print, it's worth checking your model's dimensions, structure, and printability. But what if you could do all of this directly on your phone? Meet Extrude, a free 3D model viewer app for iPhone, iPad, and Android, designed to help makers inspect their 3D models anytime, anywhere. What Is Extrude? Extrude supports a wide range of 3D file formats, including STL, 3MF, OBJ, PLY, GLB, and G-code. You can open files directly on your phone, even offline, without creating an account or uploading anything. Your files stay on your device. Extrude also includes several tools to help you prepare your models for printing: View & Measure: View 3D models and measure their dimensions. Print Check: Check printer bed fit and wall thickness. Print Estimates: Estimate printing time and filament usage. Section View: Inspect the internal structure of 3D models. AR Preview: View models at actual size in your surroundings. Available in 27 languages, Extrude is continuing to grow its user community among makers worldwide. Extrude x PCBWay: From Digital Models to Physical Parts Not every project can be completed with a desktop 3D printer. Sometimes you need a larger part, different materials, or more precise manufacturing. That's where PCBWay comes in! Starting November 23, 2026, Extrude users will see a PCBWay banner directly in the 3D viewer. Through this collaboration, users can discover PCBWay's professional manufacturing services, including 3D printing and CNC machining, with over 100 material options! Try Extrude Today! Want to inspect your 3D models more conveniently? Give Extrude a try! Verify Now Blog > Impact of the New U.S. Tariff Policy on Customs Clearance Impact of the New U.S. Tariff Policy on Customs Clearance by: PCBWay Feb 05,2025 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Summary： US imposes new tariffs on Chinese products Update on Dec 31th Current Tax Rates for Various PCBWay Products Bare PCBs : 45% Assembled boards : 35% Steel 、Aluminum& Copper (CNC,stencil, etc.) : About 85% SMT printing stencil :88% Others: General duty rates plus 10% Note: The above tax rates are estimated for reference only, as tax rates are subject to significant real-time fluctuations. NOTE: CBP has provided this chart as a courtesy for informational purposes only, and it does not constitute an official interpretation of the application of tariffs by CBP or the U.S. government. The language of each individual Executive Order and Proclamation, as well as applicable Federal Register Notices, are dispositive as to the application of tariffs to imported products. Importers are responsible for exercising reasonable care in calculating applicable tariffs to their products based on all applicable legal authorities and correctly declaring the amount to CBP on entry documentation. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Update on June 24th Current Tax Rates for Various PCBWay Products Bare PCBs : 55% Stencils : 98% SMT Services : 45% CNC Machining : 65% Aluminum & Steel Components : 73% Plastic Components : 65% Other Products : 55% Note: The above tax rates are estimated for reference only, as tax rates are subject to significant real-time fluctuations. News Update： Updated on May 8th Updated on May 15th Note: The current official Fedex website's charging standard still takes 800 as the dividing line. The dividing line between formal and informal customs declaration is 2500 In response to recent changes, we currently recommends the following logistics options: We advise using DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) logistics services with prepaid tariffs, such as: 1. DHL DTP (Duty & Tax Prepaid) , SF express If the item falls under HTS codes 9903.01.32 or 9903.01.33, it qualifies for a 10% tariff exemption. However, DHL may incorrectly apply duties. If the recipient is charged duties despite the exemption, dispute it with DHL immediately—delays may invalidate the claim. DHL DTP will prepay customs duties & taxes. DHL may contact recipients for required documentation/clarification to clear shipments (regardless of Incoterm® used). Download POA form: [POA form.pdf] Due to tariff uncertainty, we will apply a 30%~73%duty rate (current U.S. rates: 30%~73%%, with a 10% exemption for 9903.01.32/33). If the final duty rate is lower than 30%~73%, we will refund the difference upon receiving the tax invoice. For questions, contact: logistics@pcbway.com 2. FedEx-IP(DDP), Fedex-FICP (DDP – Delivered Duty Paid) FedEx DDP service will prepay customs duties & taxes. Providing an EIN or SSN will help expedite customs clearance. We recommend recipients prepare and email the 5106 Form to paperwork@fedex.com (include the tracking number in the email subject). Download forms: [5106 Form.pdf] & [PCB Worksheet.pdf] Due to tariff uncertainty, we will apply a 30%~73% duty rate. For questions, contact: logistics@pcbway.com 3. Global Direct Shipping Duties included in shipping costs. Maximum declared value per package: The logistics provider does not accept U.S.-bound shipments with a declared value exceeding $60 USD (inclusive). Global Direct Shipping is likely the most cost-effective option. Duties are included in the shipping cost, avoiding unexpected fees. Best for lower-value shipments (max declared value: $60 USD per package). No need for additional tax disputes or refund processes. If your shipment meets the value limit, this is the simplest and most economical choice. 4. Global Standard Shipping, USPS Prepaid tax fee: A 30% duty rate (based on declared value) will be charged upon package arrival. No refunds, no additional charges, and no tax invoice provided. For further inquiries, please contact: logistics@pcbway.com Update on May 12th The Government of the United States of America (the “United States”) and the Government of the People’s Republic of China (“China”), Recognizing the importance of their bilateral economic and trade relationship to both countries and the global economy; Recognizing the importance of a sustainable, long-term, and mutually beneficial economic and trade relationship; Reflecting on their recent discussions and believing that continued discussions have the potential to address the concerns of each side in their economic and trade relationship; and Moving forward in the spirit of mutual opening, continued communication, cooperation, and mutual respect; The Parties commit to take the following actions by May 14, 2025 : The United States will (i) modify the application of the additional ad valorem rate of duty on articles of China (including articles of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Macau Special Administrative Region) set forth in Executive Order 14257 of April 2, 2025, by suspending 24 percentage points of that rate for an initial period of 90 days, while retaining the remaining ad valorem rate of 10 percent on those articles pursuant to the terms of said Order; and (ii) removing the modified additional ad valorem rates of duty on those articles imposed by Executive Order 14259 of April 8, 2025 and Executive Order 14266 of April 9, 2025. China will (i) modify accordingly the application of the additional ad valorem rate of duty on articles of the United States set forth in Announcement of the Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council No. 4 of 2025, by suspending 24 percentage points of that rate for an initial period of 90 days, while retaining the remaining additional ad valorem rate of 10 percent on those articles, and removing the modified additional ad valorem rates of duty on those articles imposed by Announcement of the Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council No. 5 of 2025 and Announcement of the Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council No. 6 of 2025; and (ii) adopt all necessary administrative measures to suspend or remove the non-tariff countermeasures taken against the United States since April 2, 2025. After taking the aforementioned actions, the Parties will establish a mechanism to continue discussions about economic and trade relations. Meet PCBWay at electronica 2024! by: PCBWay Oct 18,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Once again, we welcome the famous technology event electronica in Munich, Germany! Since the first exhibition was held in 1964, electronica has gradually grown and now covers the entire world of electronics, including the micro- and nano-worlds of semiconductor and micro systems technology, as well as measurement and sensor technology, display technology and vehicle electronics, etc., which is the best choice for any technology enthusiasts and industry practitioners. PCBWay has participated in theelectronica many times and has received a warm response every time. At the exhibition, everyone has the opportunity to get close to our various products and fully evaluate the performance and quality of our products, which is far beyond the scope of online communication. On-site interaction gives us the opportunity to answer everyone's questions in a timely manner and help them understand the products more comprehensively, thereby accelerating the process of cooperation. Therefore, after the exhibition, we not only strengthened our cooperation with existing customers, but also successfully attracted the attention of many new potential partners. PCBWay will certainly not be absent from this year's exhibition.In addition, in order to give everyone a better exhibition experience and also to show how much importance PCBWay attaches to this exhibition, this year we made some innovations: Time: 2024.11.12-2024.11.15 Location: Trade Fair Center Messe München, Germany PCBWay Booth No.: A1.163 Highlights: Color- printed Boards In addition to the PCB series products, 3D printed parts and sheet metal parts that we have been displaying in the past, we will also bring the latest color-printed board samples. This new product has attracted the attention and interest of many customers, so we hope to take this opportunity to let everyone experience the excellent effect and quality of the color-printed board in person. New Booth We focused on designing the on-site booth as well. We expanded the booth area to 5m x 14m, providing a larger activity space, and also improved the sophistication of various details, in order to make the overall atmosphere more professional and make everyone's visiting experience more comfortable. The final booth design renderings are as follows: Gifts We will also bring some small gifts to the exhibition, including water cups, neck masks, and T-shirts. Welcome to come and get them! Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Fabrication Toolkit for Kicad PCBWay Fabrication Toolkit for Kicad by: PCBWay Oct 11,2023 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Recently, PCBWay added a plug-in called PCBWay Fabrication Toolkit to Kicad: With just one click of the mouse, four files can be exported from the layout file automatically: Gerber file, IPC-Netlist file, BOM file and Pick and Place file, which can significantly improves the efficiency of pre-production work. Installation from the Official KiCad Repositories After installation, the plugin will appear on the right side of the navigation bar. And users can use it to export all the production files with just a click. Process demonstration： Sending the files to PCBWay, and they can be used for production after being reviewed by the staff. Note: If you want to place an assembly order, please be sure to add MPN information to the BOM. This can help the quoter source the devices you need more accurately. Manual installation Except for the way mentioned before, you can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Fabrication-Toolkit-for-KiCad: Open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About BOM Through BOM files, we can get all information of the components used in your design. In order to speed up the quotation process, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) If you have more suggestions, please leave a message below, PCBWay has committed to providing everyone with high-quality services. Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad by: Anson Apr 01,2022 Posted in News Kicad PCB design Send your layout to PCBWay for instant production with just one click. Have you ever thought that when you complete the design on KiCad, you can place an order on pcbway with just one click? Now this idea is finally achieved (it's not an April Fool's joke). When you click PCBWay Plug-in button on Kicad, we will export these files in your project ( Please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin released at 2026 )： 1.Gerber files in correct format for production 2.IPC-Netlist file 3.Bom-file that includes all information of components 4.Pick and Place-file used in assembly You can click "Save to Cart" to place an order immediately after uploading the files( usually only takes a few seconds), our engineers will double check the files before the production. Note:We have updated plugin for Kicad 10,you could also place assembly order directly now. But we need to get the component "Manufacture Part Number". Please confirm you run the "Update Board from Schematic" and install the latest version of the plugin. ﻿ Installation from the official KiCad repositories Just open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the KiCad main menu an install the "PCBWay Plug-in for KiCad" plugin from the selection list. Manual installation You can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Plug-in-for-Kicad , then open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About Bom We can get all information of components used in your design ( please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin) . In order to speed up the quotation of components, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) You just need to add the properties in your schematic like the picture shows: As a sponsor of KiCad, we will always support its development. Note: Thanks to the open source community. Since we are not skilled enough to edit on github at the moment, any feedback or questions please contact with anson@pcbway.com Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us. Whether you're building an AI-powered smart device, developing an intelligent embedded system, or experimenting with a creative DIY project, this is your opportunity to turn an idea into a working prototype<dynamic-value> your creation with the global maker community, and compete for a share of the $2,500 prize pool. Registration and project submissions open on November 1, 2026 (PT). Get your ideas ready and join the challenge! About the PCBWay × Tindie AI Hardware Design Contest Artificial intelligence is creating new possibilities for hardware development. From intelligent sensors and smart home devices to robotics and edge AI applications, AI is changing how electronic devices interact with people and the world around them. The PCBWay × Tindie AI Hardware Design Contest aims to encourage makers and developers to explore these possibilities through practical hardware projects. By combining PCBWay's PCB manufacturing and engineering capabilities with Tindie's hardware maker community, we hope to support innovative ideas and help more creators turn their concepts into real-world products. Whether you're an experienced hardware engineer or an independent maker exploring AI for the first time, you're welcome to participate. Project Ideas and Inspiration What can you build with AI and hardware? The possibilities are endless! You are free to choose your hardware, AI models, and deployment methods. There are no fixed competition tracks or restrictions on project direction. Here are eight areas to inspire your creativity: Vision Recognition Voice and Sound Environment and Smart Home Robotics and Control Edge AI / TinyML Wearables and Assistive Devices LLMs and Physical Interaction Creative Projects and Education These ideas are only starting points, not limitations. You can explore unconventional applications, combine multiple technologies, or develop an entirely different AI hardware concept. We encourage original thinking and creative approaches. How to Participate Joining the PCBWay × Tindie AI Hardware Design Contest involves five simple steps. Step 1. Register for the Contest Both individuals and teams are welcome to participate. Complete the official contest registration form. If you have purchased products on Tindie, you can optionally provide your Tindie order number to qualify for bonus points. Once your registration is successful, you will receive an official confirmation email. Step 2. Claim Your PCBWay Manufacturing Coupon To help participants bring their hardware ideas to life, PCBWay is offering 40 manufacturing coupons worth $50 each. Participants who need PCB fabrication or related manufacturing services can select the coupon option in the registration form. Each participant can claim one coupon only. Coupons are valid only during the contest period. The coupons are available in limited quantities, so remember to indicate your interest when registering. Step 3. Build Your AI Hardware Project Now it's time to turn your idea into a working creation! Choose your own hardware project and integrate AI-related functionality. Develop and complete a working physical prototype. Document your design, implementation, and demonstration process. Your project can use different hardware platforms, AI models, and deployment methods. What matters is that you create a functioning physical project with AI-related capabilities. Step 4. Publish and Submit Your Project Once your project is ready<dynamic-value> it with the community. Publish a complete project report on a public platform. Submit your project title, description, and report link through Tindie. A demonstration video is optional but encouraged. Your project report should clearly explain the concept, hardware design, AI implementation, development process, and final results. Step 5. Project Review and Awards After the submission deadline, PCBWay and Tindie will jointly review the entries and select the winning projects. In addition to the contest prizes: Outstanding projects may receive dedicated feature coverage. Projects listed on Tindie may receive additional promotional placement. Selected creators will have opportunities to showcase their work to a wider hardware community. Prizes and Awards The PCBWay × Tindie 2026 AI Hardware Design Contest features a total prize pool of $2,500, with 17 awards across five categories. Whether you're developing an innovative AI application or building a practical hardware solution, your creativity could earn you recognition and rewards. 01.
